# MapView

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

A deck.gl map view.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/map-view",
  "type": "MapViewOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/map-view').par.x` (an input) and `op('/map-view').out.view` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.x`, `out.view`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
